reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) directly supports the premise that Mn-induced magnetic frustration eliminates the fcc-hcp energy difference and that CrCoNi undergoes a dislocation-triggered fcc-to-hcp transformation, but it does not provide evidence that this transformation promotes nanotwinning or TRIP activity, nor does it establish a direct causal link to improved strain hardening and damage tolerance across the proposed alloy series.
premises: Mn addition magnetically frustrates the alloy and eliminates the fcc-hcp energy difference
Reducing Mn content enables a dislocation-triggered fcc-to-hcp transformation
The fcc-to-hcp transformation promotes nanotwinning or TRIP activity
Enhanced nanotwinning/TRIP improves strain hardening and damage tolerance
CrCoNi exhibits superior mechanical properties relative to CrMnFeCoNi
